SEA_GLASS.KEINEMOD-KEINE_MOD.title: Antique Glass
KEINEMOD-OLD_SCROLL.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Time Shift[/gold] [blue]{TimeShiftPower}[/blue], [gold]Create[/gold] a [gold]Scroll of Valor[/gold].
KEINEMOD-OLD_SCROLL.flavor: The language written in the scroll has gone extinct.
KEINEMOD-OLD_SCROLL.title: Old Scroll
KEINEMOD-ENCHANTED_SCROLL.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Time Shift[/gold] [blue]{TimeShiftPower}[/blue], choose an [gold]Upgraded Sacred Scroll[/gold] to [gold]Create[/gold] and gain [blue]{SacredPower}[/blue] of its [gold]Sacred Power[/gold].
KEINEMOD-ENCHANTED_SCROLL.flavor: The ancient symbols glow blue, magically.
KEINEMOD-ENCHANTED_SCROLL.title: Enchanted Scroll
KEINEMOD-TEXTBOOK.title: Textbook
KEINEMOD-POCKET_WATCH.description: [gold]Time Shift[/gold] needed to gain [gold]Full Moon[/gold] is lowered to [blue]10[/blue]. You may enter [green]Hakutaku[/green] form any number of times each turn.
KEINEMOD-POCKET_WATCH.title: Pocket Watch
KEINEMOD-ETERNAL_FULL_MOON.description: At the start of turn [blue]{ActiveTurn}[/blue], gain [gold]Imperishable Night[/gold].
KEINEMOD-ETERNAL_FULL_MOON.flavor: It would be nice if it was midnight all the time.
KEINEMOD-ETERNAL_FULL_MOON.title: Eternal Full Moon
KEINEMOD-CURSED_KIMONO.description: Whenever you [gold]Consume[/gold] a card, ALL enemies lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
KEINEMOD-CURSED_KIMONO.flavor: The cause of the Great Fire of Meireki according to legend. Its owner is destined to perish.
KEINEMOD-CURSED_KIMONO.title: Cursed Kimono
